sources.title: Text recognition prebuilt AI model - AI Builder | Microsoft Learn
sources.snippet: The text recognition prebuilt model extracts words from documents and images into machine-readable character streams. It uses state-of-the-art optical character recognition (OCR) to detect printed and handwritten text in images. This model processes images and document files to extract lines of printed or handwritten text.
